name: luxury-alpine-snowboard-girl
image_purpose: Winter sport and alpine fashion social content

prompt.project_info: Create a polished alpine winter-sport fashion portrait with a snowboard.

She wears a black full-coverage athletic top, high-waisted black winter leggings, black gloves, patterned winter headband, patterned winter boots, and large dark sunglasses.
